set.body:
Source: review of AgentDomainJson versus StructuredResultCodec.

Problem:
mirror-derived codecs persist Scala case names and shapes, so renames become silent wire breaks. Byte handling and method coverage are inconsistent, and ScalaCheck is present without codec laws.

Acceptance:
- Replace derived public/protocol codecs with explicitly owned stable field names and discriminator values.
- Define unknown-field, unknown-case, bounds, and migration behavior for every request/response method.
- Add language-neutral golden fixtures, including non-ASCII bytes and every agent method.
- Add ScalaCheck round-trip, canonicalization, size-bound, and malformed-input laws for all wire and persisted codecs.
- Treat any intentional format change as a versioned compatibility decision.
set.title: P6f.12: Own every public wire codec and prove its laws
